body:
I would have agreed, except that my testing of the transparency PR showed that I needed to set `android:windowIsTranslucent` on both themes for it to take effect.

I suspect that because it's the first theme, the splash theme may set some properties that cannot be updated by the main theme. 
And so to ensure that the custom theme attributes don't run into the same problem I did, they should be applied to both themes.

body: @m4gr3d I introduced a prefix for `GodotAppSplashTheme` attributes. If `custom_theme_attributes` has a key like `[splash]android:windowIsTranslucent` it would be added to the `GodotAppSplashTheme`.

Let's add a note in the documentation that custom theme attributes cannot override the default theme attributes, as well as a warning when processing the attributes if a custom theme attribute attempts to override a default theme attribute.
